summary: Iter145 verified: preview scheduler-disable log + IS_PREVIEW_ENV True, Veo studio duration/photo/mode validation (30/40/60, avatar rejected, unknown photo 404), photo upload PNG ok + .txt 400, promo-video unknown tenant 404 + presenter→feature_tour mapping (with cleanup DELETE), promo-videos list contains tenant_name for two most recent Miracurl Unisex Family Salon promos, super admin Promo Studio UI (no avatar/presenter modes; duration buttons + generate text 'Generate 60s Cinematic Ad'; brand-contacts-toggle opens editor with save; veo-photo-input present; all 6 promo-voice-* buttons; promo-mode-tenant reveals 6-option select; 2 promo-video-tenant-badge in previous reels list), and salon Post History top badge + Best-first sort (seeded engagement, saw 'Top performer · 55' badge + Reuse highlighted, cleaned up). One BACKEND BUG found: PUT /api/super/brand-contacts with empty strings does not clear previously-stored phone/instagram (defaults never surface again). 11/12 pytest pass.

minor.issue: Cannot restore defaults by PUT with empty strings — routes/veo_studio.py brand_contacts_put filters via `{k: v.strip() for k, v in body.model_dump().items() if v and v.strip()}` so empty strings are silently ignored and hq_settings retains the old value. GET keeps returning the stale phone/instagram forever. Fix: apply `$set` for non-empty values AND `$unset` for keys sent explicitly as empty strings; or accept `null` for delete.

ui_bugs.issue: Input testids are `brand-contact-phone` / `brand-contact-instagram` (singular), but the review spec expects `brand-phone` / `brand-instagram`. Inputs work correctly; only the testid naming disagrees with the request. Consider aliasing or renaming for spec consistency.

issues: React hydration warning: <span data-ve-dynamic> injected inside <option> at PromoVideoStudio line 109 — <span> cannot be a child of <option>. Cosmetic, but React logs a hydration error. Same pattern flagged in iter144 for MiraDayOffer — likely the Emergent visual-editor wrapper is injecting the span. If unfixable at product level, may need to strip x-source-var attrs from <option> children.

action_items: Fix brand_contacts_put to allow clearing phone/instagram by explicit empty strings (use $unset for empty keys, $set for non-empty). Test spec requires PUT {phone:'', instagram:''} to restore defaults.
(Optional) Rename testids brand-contact-phone/instagram → brand-phone/brand-instagram to match spec, OR update spec to current names.
(Optional) Suppress <span> injection into <option> children in PromoVideoStudio to remove hydration warning.

rca_of_the_issue: PUT /api/super/brand-contacts empty-string reset bug — RCA: routes/veo_studio.py line 77: `vals = {k: v.strip() for k, v in body.model_dump().items() if v and v.strip()}` filters out empty strings entirely, so `update_one({key:'brand_contacts'}, {$set:{...vals}}, upsert=True)` never touches previously-set phone/instagram fields. Then services/veo_brand.get_brand_contacts merges DEFAULTS ← doc, so old value persists on GET. Repro: PUT {phone:'+91 90000 00000', instagram:'miracurl.suite'} → GET returns those values; then PUT {phone:'', instagram:''} → GET still returns old values (expected fallback to DEFAULTS''). Mitigation: for keys present in body, if empty → $unset that key; else $set. Or accept nulls for reset. Test asserts and reports this; residue is cleaned via $unset in test itself.
